name: Swetrix
description: Swetrix is a privacy-first, cookie-less web analytics platform with built-in error tracking and performance monitoring. A Google Analytics alternative that you can self-host, with the dashboard served by nginx on port 80.

notes.text: Access Swetrix in your browser at http://<container-ip>. The first run launches the onboarding flow where you create your account.
Registration is disabled by default (DISABLE_REGISTRATION=true in /opt/swetrix/backend/.env). Set it to false to allow additional account creation.
Analytics data is stored in ClickHouse at /var/lib/clickhouse. Make sure to back it up before major updates, or use the Statistics API to export your data.
If you put Swetrix behind a reverse proxy, update BASE_URL in /opt/swetrix/backend/.env and /opt/swetrix/web/.env to your public URL and restart the services.
